newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 1.42 million barrels in the week ended July 18 to 318.65 million barrels from 317.23 million barrels the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 1.03 million barrels in the week to 256.42 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 1.25 million barrels to 120.14 million barrels from 121.39 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 10.45 million barrels to 34.01 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 19,000 barrels per day in the week to 8.02 million bpd from 8.00 million bpd in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 2.79 million barrels in the week to 197.80 million barrels from 200.60 million.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 96.7 percent from 96.8 percent the prior week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 291,000 barrels to 41.00 million barrels from 41.29 million barrels the previous week.
API also said refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 fell to 100.2 percent in the week from 101.0 percent the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.92 million barrels per day from 14.91 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 37.26 million barrels from 39.14 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 8.15 million barrels per day from 7.68 million, API said.
